description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Astral Cornucopia and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.

uses.name: Astral Cornucopia
uses.cardState: with three or more charge counters on it
